title: fix(plugin-auth): an auth request is judged and executed as one account
body:
Clause-②: yes — this PR publishes one new error code, `CREDENTIALS_NAME_DIFFERENT_ACCOUNTS`, in the `@objectstack/spec` error-code ledger.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：一个认证请求若同时带着会话 cookie 和 bearer token，且两者指向两个不同的已登录账号，就在所有门禁和端点运行之前以 `401 CREDENTIALS_NAME_DIFFERENT_ACCOUNTS` 拒绝，两个账号都不写任何东西；改密码成功后的后续写入（改密时间戳、强制改密标记、密码历史）只落在端点实际改动的那个账号上；管理员撤销会话在仅用 bearer 登录时也认得出调用者。
- 为什么改：一个认证请求必须作为同一个账号被判断、被执行。
- 风险与回滚：只拒绝同时带着两个不同账号凭据的请求；单凭据、同账号的两个凭据、指向已失效会话的凭据都不受影响。Console 现有的会话读取自愈（只带 cookie 重试并丢弃 token）已实测能处理这个新拒绝，前端无改动。spec 错误码账本新增一个码，因此 Clause-② 为 yes。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/one-account-per-request.ts`（规则与判定）；`auth-manager-before-hook.ts` 中新步骤的位置（所有门禁之前）；`auth-manager-after-hook.ts` 的 `/change-password` 一段。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/one-account-per-request.test.ts`，预期 17 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**An auth request is judged and executed as one account.**

- A request whose session cookie and bearer token name two different signed-in accounts is refused before anything runs, with `401 CREDENTIALS_NAME_DIFFERENT_ACCOUNTS`, and nothing is read or written for either account. The step runs first in the global better-auth before-hook (ahead of every ObjectStack gate and of the endpoint, over HTTP and for the in-process session read), and as a middleware on the identity mount ahead of its raw ObjectStack routes, which answer it with the same code in the ADR-0112 envelope.
- Unaffected: one credential alone; two credentials naming the same account (two sessions of one user included); a credential that names no signed-in account. Two identical tokens cost no lookup.
- Fail-closed: a session read that cannot answer refuses as an outage, `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`.
- A successful `/change-password` stamps `password_changed_at`, clears a forced change and appends the history entry on the account the endpoint acted on (`ctx.context.session.user`, the reading the change-email notice already takes), and only when the password checks before it ran for that same account; otherwise none of them lands and the operator is told.
- `/admin/revoke-user-session` resolves a caller signed in by bearer alone, so a token that identifies no session is refused (`404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`) on that lane as on the cookie lane.
- `CREDENTIALS_NAME_DIFFERENT_ACCOUNTS` is registered in the `@objectstack/spec` error-code ledger under `@objectstack/plugin-auth` (no existing 401 code means "credentials name different accounts"); the three generated reference pages that list the ledger are regenerated.

## Tests

- `one-account-per-request.test.ts` (new, 17 cases, real ObjectQL over better-sqlite3 and the installed better-auth, two real accounts): the refusal on the session read (HTTP and in process), a data door's session leg, `/change-password`, `/revoke-session`, `/update-user` and the admin paths (`/admin/set-role`, `/admin/revoke-user-session`, the administrator on either credential), each asserting code and status and that nothing was written; same account on both credentials, cookie alone, bearer alone, a bearer or a cookie naming no signed-in account; the identity mount's raw admin route and its catch-all; the judgment's token reading and the 503 on a read that throws; an API key beside a session cookie is not refused by this rule; a request carrying both credentials whose judgment cannot be reached at the identity mount is answered `503` and goes no further.
- `forced-password-change-new-password.test.ts`: one new top-level describe (5 cases) — after-effects land on the account the change acted on, on the bearer lane, and on no other account.
- `admin-revoke-user-session-match-guard.test.ts`: one new top-level describe (3 cases) — the bearer lane is judged as the cookie lane.
- `change-email-delete-user-wiring.test.ts`: the two-account case now asserts the refusal, no mail and no address moved.

## Acceptance notes

- A data door that reads such a request in process sees a refused session read and resolves no account, so it answers with its own anonymous refusal; the coded `401` reaches the wire on the auth routes and the identity mount, not on the data routes. A door that re-reads an active authentication gate treats any failed session read as a store outage and answers `503` there. Carrying the code through those doors is a change in `packages/core` / `packages/runtime`, outside this PR.
- A credential that names no signed-in account leaves the request as it was (measured); this rule does not change it.
- An API key is not a session credential for this rule: a key beside a session cookie is not refused by it, and each door keeps its existing one-principal rule for keys.
- The Console needs no change: measured against the shipped `createAuthClient.getSession`, a coded `401` on the bearer-carrying read is followed by the cookie-only read, whose session and token are adopted.

## Verification

On head `7f088a82dc` (origin/main merged in) unless stated. Round 2 (`52faff29f`) adds the API-key pin and the identity mount's `503` pin: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test` Test Files 241 passed (241), Tests 4292 passed, 10 skipped; typecheck exit 0; each new pin ablated red, then restored.

<details><summary>plugin-auth suite and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck`: exit 0 (src, examples, `check:test-typecheck`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test`: Test Files 241 passed (241), Tests 4290 passed, 10 skipped (4300).

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (each leg reverted on disk, red, restored to HEAD with an empty diff)</summary>

- Before-hook step removed: 7 of the two-account pins red (session read, data door, `/change-password`, `/revoke-session`, `/update-user`, admin paths, change-email), 28 green.
- Identity mount refusal removed: 1 red (the raw admin route), 14 green.
- After-effects account rule removed: 1 red (checks run for another account), 12 green.
- Bearer-lane caller resolution removed: 1 red (zero-match token on the bearer lane), 17 green.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families</summary>

- `dispatch-gates --commands` at `7f088a82dc`: 120 families; 120 run, reconciled with `--ran` (120 derived, 120 run, 0 unrun).
- 118 exit 0 on the first pass; `check:skill-examples` refused for an unbuilt `@objectstack/client-react` and exited 0 once that closure was built; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED (it needs the whole workspace built), left to CI.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: one stale artifact (the reference docs) regenerated with `gen:docs`.

</details>
